purpose: Diagnostic paired live evaluation, not held-out confirmation or release acceptance
order: Exact listed five-run schedule from v2 unattempted suffix. No prior attempted arm is retried.
completion_token_note: Five investigations, each at most two512 selections plus one1024 diagnosis:10240reservedcompletiontokens. Inputtokens not fixed; missing usage unknown.
stop: Record and continue after diagnosis-only structured-output rejection HTTP400/json_validate_failed or exact DiagnosisError during diagnosis content/validation. Stop on all other errors, including rate limit, auth, transport/timeout, storage/retrieval, input limits, unknown errors, budget/deadline. Never retry, repair, fall back, or automatically start another batch.
candidate: Frozen v3 title-context nearest-passage document selection at0.30; exact Mechanism/Checks expansion under existing bounds. Failed held-out confirmation retained; experiment only.
integration: Real shared LangGraph build_investigation_graph, initial state, tools, prompts, strict diagnosis validation. Evaluator supplies experimental RetrievalPin and lookup callback; normal pin_corpus acceptance/default app runtime is unchanged. Ephemeral in-memory graph, not durable resume validation.
fairness: Same model/options/input/available snapshots/budgets per pair. Do not preload or force runbook calls. Compare final observation sets; flag evidence differences because retrieval competes with health/log tools.
quality_review: Auto-check structure, evidence/source membership and budgets; matched expected status alone is not semantic correctness. Generate manual claim-by-claim observation support, document support, useful-check, abstention and pair-regression worksheet. Reviewer identity required. Overall quality remains unassessed until semantic review; assistant review is not independent human review.
live_authorization: Requires separate bounded user approval after offline harness verification, --live and --approve-protocol matching the exact protocol SHA256. No credentials read/client constructed in fake mode.
limits: No commit before agreed acceptance and user review

pacing.note: Conservative fixed spacing, not an account-quota guarantee. No other organization traffic is controlled. Does not resolve daily exhaustion. Waiting counts against batch deadline; no request starts at or after deadline.

published_reference.note: Public table, not verified account allowance; organization-wide traffic and daily balance unknown.
